messages: tasha: Heads-up: I'm starting a guided docs reorg this afternoon. Plan is to move /guides -> /reference/guides, add a small redirect manifest, then split a few long pages. Opening multiple PRs and want an explicit merge order to avoid anchor breakage. ryan: Please list the PRs and the order you want them merged. I can watch previews and run the smoke checks. tasha: Opening PRs: 8470 (redirect manifest + smoke job), 8471 (index move + placeholder landing pages), 8472 (split auth + deploy guides), 8473 (examples + SDK snippets), 8474 (anchor-alias mappings). My suggested order: 8470 -> 8471 -> 8474 -> 8472 -> 8473. emily: Why 8474 after 8471? Wouldn't mapping after split be more accurate? tasha: Two reasons: 1) 8470/8471 give immediate safe redirects so previews don't 404 a lot; 2) 8474 is small and can add alias anchors proactively for known external links so splits don't cause SEO/redirect churn. zane: I'm +1 for minimal, fast changes first. If 8470 includes a CI smoke job, we can catch anchor regressions early. dryan: docs-bot posted previews. I'll run the smoke locally too. Previews: 8470 https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8470/ 8471 https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8471/ 8472 https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8472/ docs-bot: [preview-posted] PR 8470 preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8470/ :white_check_mark: tasha: Proposed small rollout window: merge 8470 at 15:30 PT, then 8471 at 16:15 PT, then 8474 and 8472 in sequence. If anything spikes we can pause and rollback the index move. emily: I'll be available for post-merge link checks. Also tag localization — moving files changes keys. zane: I'll open INFRA-1312 to lower CDN TTLs for the rollout window and add a canary rule for /reference/guides/* so we can confirm new redirects without impacting everyone. tasha: Good. Adding a short smoke script snippet to 8470: `yarn workspace docs build && node scripts/link-smoke.js` where link-smoke follows redirects up to 5 hops and checks anchors. ryan: Add retry (3 tries) and 2s backoff for flaky previews. Last migration we had transient 502s. tasha: Will add retries. Also including a tiny JSON redirect manifest in 8470 with top 30 common anchors. emily: For examples/snippets, if import paths change, let's provide compatibility includes for one release. 8473 can add a compat include preserving old `import {Client} from '@redwood/sdk'` lines. zane: INFRA-1312 created. Will coordinate cache header changes and a canary purge procedure. Linking in PRs. dryan: Minor note: external links to auth guide anchors might include hyphen/no-hyphen variants. Add alias anchors in 8474 or as small HTML anchor tags in 8471 to cover both. tasha: Adding anchor alias plan to 8474. Also adding a tiny meta-refresh landing page at the old index path in 8471 so crawlers land on a useful page while redirects propagate. docs-bot: [merge] PR 8470 merged by ryan at 1769712956 :tada: ryan: 8470 merged. Smoke job kicked on main. Locally smoke passed; CI running. emily: CI smoke job reports green on main. Proceeding to rebase 8471. tasha: Rebased 8471 on main and updated redirect manifest to include the most frequent external anchors. Pushing small tidy commits to keep diffs reviewable. dryan: Quick check: `guides/advanced/caching.md` had `#kv-cache` anchor but some old links use `#kvcache`. Can we add `` in the new file so both work? tasha: Will add that alias in 8471. Also adding a note to the PR about localization impact and tagging @localization. docs-bot: [merge] PR 8471 merged by ryan at 1769713956 :white_check_mark: ryan: 8471 merged. Netlify preview of main looks stable; no mass 404s. tasha: Opening 8474 now with a focused anchor-alias map and a tiny test suite. Requesting quick reviews from emily and ryan. emily: Reviewing 8474. Found a missing alias for `/guides/auth#token-rotation`. Pushing suggestion. tasha: Fixed and pushed. 8474 is tiny so should be quick to land. docs-bot: [merge] PR 8474 merged by emily at 1769714556 :tada: emily: 8474 merged. Anchor aliases are live. I'll run a full grep for old anchor variants and file a follow-up if anything is left. tasha: Starting 8472 (splits). This one's review-heavy. Will open WIP commits and keep them small. Please check frontmatter slugs and include paths so previews render. ryan: I'll prioritize 8472 review. After it lands I'll run snippet path checks and prepare 8473 updates. emily: Don't forget to update the sitemap after final merges and to coordinate with translations. tasha: Plan is to merge 8473 tomorrow morning to allow CDN TTLs to settle and localization imports to finish. Posting a short summary in #announcements once done. :rocket:
